fit: alcoholic leaf extract and cognition or recorded agitation
assessment: Alzheimer trial randomized 42. Table 2 reports agitation in 1 extract versus 6 placebo participants, p=.03. Cognition was the efficacy endpoint. No brewed or depressive severity comparison.

fit: topical essential oil and severe dementia agitation
assessment: Twenty-one of 35 active and five of 36 placebo completers met the reported agitation response threshold. The comparator was sunflower-oil lotion. Neither route nor endpoint fits the frozen claim.

fit: published scoring comments on the 2002 topical cohort
assessment: Same cohort as PMID:12143909. The letter flags uncertainty in verbal subscale scoring. Reply does not supply a new denominator or depression measure.

fit: topical oil and Alzheimer agitation, blinded comparison
assessment: Of 114 randomized, 94 were assessed at week 4 and 81 at week 12. No group advantage was detected on the reported comparisons. The study tested agitation rather than depressive symptom severity.

fit: injected isolated caffeine and mouse striatal barrier outcomes
assessment: Barrier leakage, striatal physiology and tissue measurements in the MPTP study do not establish a brewed coffee or clinical fatigue effect. Companion to the 2008 meeting comparison.

fit: coffee subtype and cardiovascular event cohort
assessment: Subtype-specific coffee intake was self-reported. Some cardiovascular associations differed between caffeinated and decaffeinated types. Fatigue was outside the recorded endpoints.
